author: reek
body: Runtime probe: the four network helpers consult the per-process capability word before driving the NE2000. The program declares Network.Read, so the boot grant derived from its own manifest includes cap-network-read and the first status read succeeds. It then strips its own grant word in the process table and asks again. The kernel refuses with -1 without touching the device.

author: reek
body: Before 2026-07-13 there was nothing to refuse with: the bits were defined, granted, and read by nobody, so a stripped grant changed nothing and the NIC answered anyway.
